Mod.Name: Floating HP Bar
Mod.Author: JustPeace
Mod.Description: Displays floating enemy names and HP bars. Auto mode removes the 10000 HP script reserve for vanilla non-dying bosses identified by Memoria, and uses engine logical HP for Alternate Fantasy. Configure FloatingHPBar/FloatingHPBar.ini.
Mod.PatchNotes: Version 1.2: fixed vanilla scripted bosses showing 10000 extra HP in Auto mode. Display-only change; no battle data modifications. Compiled and calculation-tested; in-game boss regression pending. Version 1.1: enemy names above the bar; fixed boss HP display (no more unconditional -10 000); added HpMode, ShowName and NameFontSize options. Version 1.0: first release.
